host.description: Register all functions from stdlib/string.schema-fragment.json. Context t is Trace: int records int N, float records float %.15g, bool records bool true|false, hex records hex SPACE followed by lowercase hexadecimal bytes (two digits per byte, no decoding). bytes(string) decodes an even-length ASCII hexadecimal fixture literal to raw bytes, without recording a trace. This helper intentionally supplies invalid UTF-8 and NUL without depending on source encoding or compiler literal escapes. Strings, offsets and lengths are bytes. Runtime error expectations use exact code/line/column and message substring, matching the core runner.
